evidence_preference: CUSTOMER_CONFIRMED_USE or COUNTERPARTY_CONFIRMATION or decision_reason containing 客户确认/直接客户
manufacturing_group.pair_choice: Among eligible companies, choose the pair with the largest common-function set K (|K|>=2); ties by evidence rank then lexicographic company_id pair.

logistics_group.prefer_contrasting_delivery: If one ROBOT_OPERATED_SERVICE company qualifies, pair it with a SYSTEM_PRODUCTS logistics observed-use company that has the strongest customer-side evidence. Multi-product companies are lower priority because product-scene assignment of hiring is unclear.
logistics_group.unified_weight_not_required: If |K|<2, keep company point values and mark unified-weight comparison INAPPLICABLE.

anti_example_search: Search all candidates meeting the same scene/scope conditions; do not only keep companies that fit an expected hiring mix.
